title: Catch!
lines: Dan and his pup like a game of catch.
Dan pitches a stick up the hill.
The pup runs and catches it. Dan claps.
Then Dan pitches the stick to the top.
It lands in a wet ditch by the path.
The pup will not go in the ditch.
Dan calls it, but the pup will not go.
So Dan hops in and catches the stick.
His pants have a big patch of mud.
He pitches the stick back up the hill.
This time the pup catches it. Dan grins.
Mom hands Dan a rag for his pants.

questions.ask: Where did the stick land when Dan pitched it to the top?
questions.listenFor: In a wet ditch by the path. Stated in the story - have them reread that line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Dan have a patch of mud on his pants?
questions.listenFor: He hopped into the ditch to get the stick himself. Cause and effect - if they say "mud," ask "how did he get in the mud?"

questions.ask: Do you think the pup was scared of the ditch? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. You want a reason from the text - "it would not go in" is exactly the kind of evidence you are after.
